Meet The Owner

How Proguard Started

George Inman is the third generation of roofing and building contractors in his family. Proguard is a family run business with 25 years behind it.

Today it's a team of 5 based in Burgess Hill, doing new roofs, flat roofs, uPVC fascias, guttering and soffits, repairs, chimneys and lead work for homeowners across Sussex.

"Hard working, reliable, and we treat customers' homes like our own."
George InmanOwner, Proguard Roofing and Guttering
